extDescription: Records calls in the browser (Teams, Google Meet, Zoom, Jitsi, Webex and any other site) and sends them to the Koalino app on this computer.
accessMissing: Koalino may not run on the meeting sites (Teams, Google Meet, Zoom, Jitsi, Webex, Whereby) yet, so it cannot notice your calls there or fetch Teams transcripts.
alwaysRecordHint: Otherwise you are asked when a call starts.
useCaptionsHint: Names who spoke when; turned on in the call for you only.
fetchTranscript: Fetch the Teams transcript after the meeting
fetchTranscriptHint: Whoever started it, when your account can see it.
startTranscription: Start Teams transcription when I record
startTranscriptionHint: Everyone sees it, and Microsoft stores the transcript.
helperMissing: Helper not installed: run “browser-host install” from Koalino.
appNotRunning: Koalino app not running (or its meeting bridge is off); recordings wait.
accessAllowed: Allowed. Reload any meeting tab that was already open.
accessRefused: Not allowed: Koalino cannot notice calls on the meeting sites until you allow it. “Record this tab” still works.
statusAppNotRunning: Koalino isn't running: open it now. Until then only the last 4 minutes are kept
transcriptAlreadySent: Teams transcript of {title} already sent to Koalino.
transcriptNoMatch: Teams transcript on screen ({time}): no recorded meeting matches.
transcriptSent: Teams transcript of {title} sent to Koalino.
transcriptFailedRetrying: Teams transcript of {title}: {reason}; trying again in a minute.
recapNoTranscriptTab: the recap has no Transcript tab
recapNothingArrived: the transcript could not be downloaded
recapWrongSession: Teams showed another session's recap, and none listed matches the recording
matchSpokenLanguage: Set Teams' spoken language to Koalino's
matchSpokenLanguageHint: When Koalino has a fixed language. It changes the language for the whole meeting, and others may see it.
recordCallQuestion: Looks like a call on {site}. Record it with Koalino?
recordThisTabHint: Records the sound and shared screen of a call on any site.
cannotRecordTab: This tab can't be recorded (a browser page, or a site the browser keeps extensions from).
watchAllSitesHint: Offers to record a call on any site, not only the meeting sites. Asks to read all sites; nothing leaves this computer.
siteChoices: Your choices: always on {always}; never on {never}.
